name: kyfes
description: Know Your Frontend: secure, predictable frontends generated with Claude Code. One src/ layout for React, Next.js, Vue, Angular and SvelteKit; HttpOnly/Secure cookie sessions via BFF, CSRF, CSP and XSS guards; axios/HttpClient behind a single client; TanStack Query; CASL RBAC on every CRUD action; i18n; accessible charts; guardrail hooks, a stop gate and dedicated agents.
